thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: streaming latency SLO breach detected. p95 rose from ~320ms -> ~1.1s, p99 from ~1.8s -> ~4.2s over last 12m. Spike correlates with prefix-cache hitrate drop. ticket=INC-5392. Please ack and triage.

sarah (oncall): acked. pulling dashboards now. seeing a sharp drop in prefixcache hit rate (global) from ~92% -> ~28% starting ~22:12 UTC. streaming tail stalls at token boundaries (128/512) and a bunch of sessions stuck in long polling state. tagging SRE/Runtime.

chi (sre): @sarah can you paste the cache metric query? I'm checking eviction/ttl graphs.

sarah (oncall): query: `sum(rate(prefixcache.requests[5m])) by (region), sum(rate(prefixcache.hits[5m])) by (region)` ; sample: us-west1 requests +350% and hits down 70%. logs show prefixhash mismatch errors for kvbucket lookup: `prefix_key_v1 != prefix_key_v2` around rollout timestamp.

omar (eng-runtime): I saw the prefix-hash rollout job from 22:10 UTC. Canary was green but looks like collision for older shards. Running quick sanity: `kubectl exec -n runtime prefix-validator -- cat /etc/prefix/hash_version` -> returned `v2` on some pods and `v1` on others.

elaine (devops): deploy-bot: `deploy-canary prefix-hash v2` at 22:10 UTC -> success. However I see partial config propagation to edge pods due to slow configmap refresh.

devbot: :gear: Canary rollback job queued (id: rb-2413001). Use `/deploy rollback rb-2413001` to start.

sarah (oncall): mitigation plan (short): 1) Rollback prefix-hash to v1 in canary and edge; 2) Route streaming traffic to fallback model-variant that avoids prefixcache for 10m; 3) Enable prefetch for top-hot prefixes to warm cache; 4) Increase stream chunk timeout to prevent stalls; 5) Notify impacted customers and start postmortem.

omar (eng-runtime): starting rollback now. command: ```
/ops/rollout --component=prefix-hash --target=canary --to-version=v1 --force
``` output: `rolled back 12/12 canary pods` (2409876805)

devbot: :white_check_mark: Rollback succeeded for canary. Triggering edge sync.

e laine (devops): (typo fixed) applying routing change: `route-policy streaming: prefer=fallback-v1 ttl=600s` — pushing to us-west1/us-east1.

sarah (oncall): enabling prefetch for top-200 prefixes: `prefetcher.enable --top=200 --region=global` (started 2409876860). Also bumped stream buffer timeout from 30s -> 60s in streaming-proxy config.

chi (sre): verifying metrics: p95 dropped from 1.1s -> 430ms over last 3m after rollback + routing change. p99 is down from 4.2s -> ~1.2s. prefixcache global hitrate climbed to ~68% and still warming.

customer-ops: drafting customer notification: small set of customers may have experienced streaming stalls and token drops between 22:12-22:55 UTC. recommending opt-in for replays; will post follow-up.

sarah (oncall): live note: observed some partial responses where the stream resumed but with small gaps. We should mark those sessions for playback/QA. Creating ticket INC-5392-REPRO with example session ids.

omar (eng-runtime): followup action: add a configmap hash-check in rollout pipeline to prevent mixed-version edge/compute pairings. quick patch PR opened: `runtime/rollout#459`.

elaine (devops): side-effect: configmap sync lag was due to kube-apiserver throttle on control plane during one upgrade window. I removed the high-frequency watcher on prefix-config which reduced churn. Monitoring for 15m.

devbot: incident-bot: `incident INC-5392` state=mitigated -> monitoring; assigned to sarah, owners: eng-runtime/ops/sre.

sarah (oncall): handing off to night oncall @raj at 00:30 UTC. Handoff summary: rollback to v1 completed, routing to fallback-v1 in place (ttl 10m), prefetch warming in progress, stream timeout increased, p95/p99 improved but still watching tail. Pending: cache warmup to reach >85% hitrate, confirm no further configmap propagation lags, follow-up customer comms + postmortem.

raj (next-oncall): ack. I'll take 30m watch and escalate if p99 > 2s or hitrate < 65% after warmup window. please push any session repros to INC-5392-REPRO.

sarah (oncall): thanks team. logging final commands run:
```
kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deploy/prefix-hash-canary --to-revision=v1
adminctl route update streaming --policy=fallback-v1 --ttl=600
prefetcherctl start --top=200 --scope=global
proxyctl config set stream_timeout=60s
```

sarah (oncall): final live status (2409877143): p95=420ms, p99=1.1s, prefixcache hitrate=74%. Monitoring continues. Creating follow-up PMR & postmortem actions.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-5392 marked as mitigated — watch window started.
